topic: why a movie theater keeps far more of what you spend on snacks than on your ticket
storyAngle: The ticket mostly goes back to the studio; the snacks are where the theater keeps its money.
doNotClaim: These are 2024 cost ratios from the 10-K, not profit margins.
Do not say popcorn specifically; the 10-K groups all food and beverage.
Do not claim any other theater chain does the same.

facts.claim: AMC food and beverage COSTS were 17.3% of food and beverage revenues in 2024 (17.4% in 2023).
facts.note: search summary of the 10-K; confirm in filing

facts.claim: AMC film exhibition costs were 51.6% of admissions revenues in 2024 (50.8% in 2023). Film exhibition costs are what a theater pays to show films.
AMC food and beverage revenue per patron was $8.30 in 2024, up from $7.95.

derived.claim: After food and beverage costs about 82.7% of that revenue remains (100 - 17.3), before other expenses.
After film exhibition costs about 48.4% of admissions revenue remains (100 - 51.6), before other expenses.
